1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said alignment device comprises a hardware processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium, and wherein the alignment device produces a functional change in the apparatus by automatically identifying and highlighting procedural steps on a user interface based on the computed alignment.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and wherein the identification of the current step causes a functional change in the display state of the user interface.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification of the user interface that is dependent upon the computed alignment.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification of the displayed procedure that is dependent upon the computed alignment.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and wherein the identification of the next step causes a functional change in the display state of the user interface.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification of the user interface that is dependent upon the computed alignment.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification of the displayed procedure that is dependent upon the computed alignment.

8. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the at least one similarity metric is based on a similarity of an action type involved in both a demonstrated user action and a document action, and wherein the similarity metric is computed by the hardware processor to produce a functional change in the apparatus by automatically determining procedural alignment.

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and wherein the use of previous user experiences produces a functional change in the apparatus by improving the accuracy of procedural alignment.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, wherein the document action extractor comprises a hardware processor executing instructions that produce a functional change in the apparatus by parsing and organizing procedural steps.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device comprising a hardware processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the alignment device produces a functional change in the apparatus; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification of the user interface dependent upon the computed alignment; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, wherein the scrolling produces a functional change in the display state of the user interface.

14. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein the alignment device, highlighting device, and scrolling device each comprise hardware processors executing instructions that collectively produce a functional change in the apparatus by automatically guiding user actions through procedural steps.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and wherein the use of previous user experiences produces a functional change in the apparatus by improving the accuracy of procedural alignment.

17. (Currently amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric using a hardware processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium, wherein the computing step produces a functional change in a computer system by automatically identifying procedural alignment.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, wherein the identifying step produces a functional change in the computer system by modifying the display state of a user interface.

22.
